builds.title: Icon map and icon packs: every icon and badge in the app, swappable
builds.detail:
1. Icon map: a registry of EVERY icon, badge and logo slot in the whole app (every plugin, screen, dialog, menu, toolbar, tab, nav item, banner, widget and button that shows an icon). Each slot gets a stable id, its location and a role (e.g. 'save', 'approve', 'build-running'), and registers through the framework manifest so new plugins appear automatically. Add a CI check that fails on hard-coded icons not in the map.
2. Icon map screen: a searchable, filterable, categorized tree of every slot with a live preview, where you click a slot to change its icon. Ties into the UI Manager.
3. Icon pack template: one pack file maps every role to an icon. Applying a pack changes every icon in the app in one click. Per-slot overrides with Restore previous edit / Restore from axHub.
4. Packs: ship a lot of packs (outline, filled, rounded, duotone, sharp, glyph, emoji-style, plus badge styles and app/plugin logos). Some are themable (follow skin tokens for colour and stroke), others are fixed-colour. Each pack declares whether it's themable. Licences must allow redistribution; prefer open icon sets.
5. Packs are assets: swappable, per-skin defaults, shareable via the hub asset library, importable.
6. Full API: REST/MCP/CLI/voice ('switch to the duotone icon pack'). Tests, help, Shipped features. Use Fable for the registry/schema and asset type.

A timeline shows the chain of edits, each with time, who/what made it, and a diff of exactly which tokens changed (old -> new). Click any snapshot to preview it, compare any two, or revert to it (a revert is itself a new snapshot, so nothing is ever lost). No breaking skins into separate style or colour groups: the skin is the only unit.
5. EXPORT: at any point, 'Export current to new skin' saves the current state as a brand-new skin (name, thumbnail, to the hub library).

builds.detail: Bug seen three times on Nov 13 (ui-manager-floating-window-to-select-any: Earl/Gina, Gina/Paulie, Lenny/Paulie): the orchestrator's dispatcher launched the same build phase twice on the same worktree, so two headless sessions wrote the same files at once. builds.title: Auto-land: every finished build lands itself immediately
builds.detail:
Brett is sick of finished builds sitting unlanded until they're thousands of commits behind. Make auto-land the DEFAULT for every build (the per-build switch stays, default ON):
- The moment a build finishes and its tests pass, the server lands it on main (build_land logic: push, merge origin/main, union-merge THREADS/STATUS/decisions, settle orchestrator JSON, check JSON, push).
- Lands go through ONE serial landing queue, so two lands never race (fixes 'cannot lock ref origin/main').
- On a code clash or failing test, the server automatically queues a P0 'merge main and land' fix build for it and keeps retrying until it lands. Brett gets an FYI notification for each attempt, not a question.
- A build that's still running gets main merged into its branch every 30 minutes, so it never falls far behind.
- A sweeper runs every 10 minutes: any finished-but-unlanded build is landed or gets its fix build.
- A banner/badge shows the landing queue and anything stuck for over 30 minutes.
- Full API and voice. Tests, help, Shipped features.

builds.title: Voice listener: use Claude when connected (setting)
builds.detail: Follow-up to console-app-wake-word-voice-listener (scripted, offline command catalog plus spoken wizard). Add a setting 'Understand with Claude when connected' (default ON). When the Claude badge is green, the transcribed speech goes to Claude with the voice command catalog (from the API registry) as tools, so Brett can talk freely: Claude picks the command, fills fields from what he said, asks only for what's missing, and confirms destructive actions. When Claude isn't connected or times out, it falls back to the scripted matcher and wizard, with a small 'offline mode' indicator. Approvals still need an explicit spoken approve/deny. Show which mode handled each command in the history. Full API and voice ('use Claude for voice'). Tests, help, Shipped features.

notes.text: Queued by console.

Brett: the setting must be a real on/off switch. OFF = always scripted/offline even while Claude is connected (no speech text sent to Claude at all). Add a test that proves it: with Claude connected and the switch off, a command is handled by the scripted matcher and no Claude request is made. Show the current mode on the listener UI.
Split by Claude into 14 steps (0 Fable).
